title: Market scout
objective: Enumerate every serious option in this space by name, with what each one is and who it is for.
lane: the landscape: who the players are, what category each belongs to, how they are positioned
not_lane: pricing detail, licence terms, failure modes — other seats own those

title: Economics and constraints
objective: Establish what each option actually costs and what hard limits it imposes.
lane: pricing models, quotas, rate limits, licence terms and their commercial restrictions
not_lane: which option is best; feature comparison

title: Fundamentals
objective: Cover the basics the specialists will collectively skip: what this class of thing is, the standard decision factors, and the vocabulary a newcomer needs.
lane: definitions, how the decision is normally framed, what the standard evaluation criteria are

title: Skeptic
objective: Find what the other seats will miss, and argue against whatever consensus is forming. Specifically hunt for options and objections a well-informed critic would raise that nobody has mentioned.
lane: failure modes, migration pain, overlooked alternatives, the case against the obvious answer
